literal: Even if I wear a branch flower, she will get angry, saying, 'You wore it to show to another woman!'
translation: Even if I wear a flower plucked from a tree branch, she will get angry and say, 'You wore this only to show it off to some other woman!'
modern: மரக்கிளையில் மலர்ந்த பூவை நான் சூடிக்கொண்டாலும், 'வேறொரு பெண்ணுக்குக் காட்டுவதற்காகவே இதனைச் சூடினீர்' என்று கூறி அவள் என்னோடு ஊடல் கொள்வாள்.
explanation: In this couplet from the chapter on the subtleties of lovers' tiffs, the hero laments his beloved's playful jealousy. Even an innocent act like wearing a flower from a tree branch (கோட்டுப் பூ) triggers her suspicion. She immediately accuses him of wearing it to show off (காட்டிய) to another woman (ஒருத்தியை). The word 'காயும்' captures her swift, feigned anger, which is a characteristic part of their intimate lovers' tiff.
